title: Palindromic Substrings
description: Count all palindromic substrings in a given string.

data.text: Given a string `s`, return the number of palindromic substrings in it.

data.title: Check all O(n^3)
Expand O(n^2) O(1)
What improved?
data.text: Each center expansion counts palindromes in one pass. We no longer re-check every substring from scratch.
